identity._identity_note: THE NAME ITSELF IS STAKEHOLDER-ASSERTED, NOT YET HARDWARE-CONFIRMED (pxt-nezha-diffdrive sprint 040 ticket 005, 2026-09-21). geometry._note: UNMEASURED as of sprint 040 ticket 005 (pxt-nezha-diffdrive, 2026-09-21). Every geometry number a Nezha-fleet robot's firmware_bake normally carries here -- trackwidth, motors, lag_s, stop_distance_mm, rotational_slip, accel -- is Sprint 041's job: a caliper/bench bring-up against the physical Cutebot Pro, per docs/design/cutebot-pro-support.md Sec.8 (revision probe, encoder sign/resolution, travel_calib, rotational_slip, the 0x80 onboard-loop floor, the hybrid-actuation handoff probes). `firmware_bake.board` is the ONLY key this file sets; do not invent any of the others ahead of that measurement -- an invented number here would look identical to a measured one to every downstream reader.
